Join our team

Do the kind of work that warms the heart

If you’re warm, reliable and genuinely enjoy the company of older people, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Arkand

Care work as it should be — kind, unhurried and valued.

We believe you can’t give good care if you’re rushed off your feet. So we do things differently: proper time with each person, familiar visits you’ll look forward to, and the support of a team that treats you as well as we treat the people we care for.

Whether you’ve years of experience or a caring heart and a willingness to learn, there could be a place for you at Arkand.

What we look for

The heart matters most

Genuine warmth

You’re kind, patient and a good listener — the sort of person who brightens a room just by walking in.

Reliability

People are counting on you. Turning up on time, every time, with a smile, is care in itself.

Respect & dignity

You treat every person, and every home, with the same respect you’d want for your own family.

What we offer

A role that gives back

Meaningful work, real support, and the time to do it properly.

  • •

    Proper time with people

    No rushing between visits — time to build real relationships.

  • •

    Familiar, local visits

    The same lovely people to see, arranged thoughtfully around you.

  • •

    Friendly, supportive team

    You’re never on your own — we look after each other.

  • •

    Flexible hours

    Roles to fit around your life, whatever your availability.
